description: Taker flow of one coin over a window: buy vs sell volume, delta and cumulative volume delta in total, per venue, by print size and for tracked whales, plus the volume profile (point of control, value area). Use it for "who is buying BTC?".

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: Window in hours (default 24; clamped to the order-flow history of the plan: free keys and no key 24; the answer says when it was cut).

name: get_order_flow

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

title: Order flow (CVD)
